articles.title: AfD celebrate projected win in Saxony-Anhalt
articles.summary: AfD leaders celebrated tonight as exit polls projected a big lead in the Saxony-Anhalt vote.
articles.body:
Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) is celebrating as exit polls show they are set to win more than 44% of the vote in the eastern state of Saxony-Anhalt.

The AfD's projected result is higher than earlier opinion polls suggested and the party has hailed the news as a "historic outcome".

However, party leaders will not know if they have enough seats to govern until they see which of the smaller parties get into the state parliament.

That may hinge on whether one of the smaller parties gets over the required threshold of 5%.

Berlin correspondent Jess Parker reports from the AfD party HQ as supporters celebrated the projected results.

articles.title: Is Hezbollah weakened as Lebanon shifts towards new governance?
articles.summary: Lebanon has a new president and prime minister – but can they challenge groups like Hezbollah for dominance?
articles.body:
Beirut, Lebanon – A new president. A new prime minister. And the sense that Hezbollah, arguably the most powerful group in the country, has been weakened.

It has been a potentially transformative few weeks in Lebanon, particularly when taken in the context of a political system that often appears frozen.

The developments have been a cause for celebration among many Lebanese, but they also could lead to questions for the entire political class, including Hezbollah.

Hezbollah, a Shia political group and militia, has dominated Lebanon for the better part of the past two decades. But in the past few months, it has suffered numerous setbacks, including the loss of most of its senior members, including its leader Hassan Nasrallah, in its war with Israel and subsequently the fall of its staunch ally, Bashar al-Assad’s regime in Syria.

“Hezbollah still has legitimacy,” Ziad Majed, a Lebanese political researcher, told Al Jazeera. “It will have to accept to be a strong – and it will be strong – Lebanese party like all the others but without the ownership of the decision of war and peace.”

Hezbollah helped Joseph Aoun get the required number of votes to become president by backing him in the second round of voting on January 9. But the group, which had planned to support incumbent Najib Mikati in the vote for prime minister on January 13, abstained after it became clear Nawaf Salam , the former president of the International Court of Justice, would win.

Hezbollah MP Mohammad Raad said the group had extended a hand to the nation by voting for Aoun but Salam’s nomination saw that “hand cut off”.

The Iranian-backed group feels that many of its opponents in government are taking advantage of the losses it suffered in Israel’s war on Lebanon.

In his first speech as prime minister-designate, however, Salam promised to unite the Lebanese people and spoke to issues that impact the Shia community deeply after Israel’s war on the country . Israel’s attacks on Lebanon focused predominantly on areas with high Shia populations, even in areas where many locals said Hezbollah military infrastructure or fighters were not present, including southern Lebanon, much of the Bekaa Valley and Beirut’s suburbs widely referred to as Dahiyeh .

Much like Aoun’s speech a few days earlier, Salam said he would work to make sure Israel’s military withdraws “from the last occupied inch of [Lebanese] land” and the areas impacted by Israel’s devastating attacks would be rebuilt.

“Reconstruction is not just a promise but a commitment,” he said.

“He is smart enough to find the appropriate ways to try to be inclusive,” Karim Emile Bitar, an international relations professor at Saint Joseph University in Beirut, told Al Jazeera. “I do not think he will try to exclude the Shia constituency from participating in government and state building, but this is a decision the Shia parties have to make.”

Hezbollah is, however, in a precarious position. For years, Hezbollah and its allies were politically and militarily influential enough to block decisions they opposed, such as government formations that didn’t satisfy their needs. In one of the most well-known examples of the group’s power, Hezbollah deployed fighters to the streets of Beirut in May 2008 after the Lebanese government ordered the dismantling of the group’s private telecommunications network, forcing the state authorities to backtrack.

But the fall of the al-Assad regime in Syria has made receiving weapons more difficult and removed a key regional ally for the group.

Under the terms of the ceasefire with Israel, Hezbollah is supposed to move north of the Litani River, which runs across southern Lebanon from north of Tyre in the west to just south of Marjayoun in the east, and the Lebanese army is to deploy in southern Lebanon after the Israelis withdraw from the territory.

Hezbollah has said its military infrastructure must only be removed from the south, but Israel has recently attacked targets north of the Litani that it said are associated with Hezbollah. However, some officials in Israel and the United States – and even Lebanon – have said Hezbollah’s military infrastructure should be targeted anywhere in Lebanon. This leaves questions over whether all parties have the same understanding of the ceasefire.

Aoun and Salam have both spoken about the state having a monopoly on weapons and deploying to southern Lebanon, a clear message to Hezbollah that its military supremacy may be over.

Whether Hezbollah will accept that is a different matter. On Saturday, Hezbollah Secretary-General Naim Qassem warned that Hezbollah must be included in any incoming government.

“[No one can] exclude us from effective and influential political participation in Lebanon as we are a fundamental component of the country’s makeup and its renaissance,” Qassem said before adding that no force was able to “take domestic advantage of the results of the [Israeli] aggression, for the political path is separate from the situation of the resistance [Hezbollah]”.

Lebanon’s new leaders have promised to ensure Israel withdraws from every centimetre of southern Lebanon and to rebuild its destroyed homes and villages in what analysts believe is an effort at extending a hand to the Shia community.

Hezbollah is under pressure from its constituencies in the south, the Bekaa Valley and Dahiyeh to rebuild their homes and lives. For that, analysts said, Lebanon will need international aid. This could lead Hezbollah to accept the new political direction for Lebanon for the time being.

“Either [Hezbollah] allows the rebuilding to happen in a way that is state-led and has sufficient legitimacy from [Arab] Gulf donors who are willing to put their money in, or it’s not going to happen,” Nadim Houry, executive director of the Arab Reform Initiative, said.

And there are indications that, despite the rhetoric from some, Hezbollah may be open to a more conciliatory path, at least in the short term.

“The important thing is to rebuild state institutions, achieve political, financial and economic reform, implement the ceasefire agreement and follow up on the implementation of the Taif Agreement,” Qassem Kassir, a political analyst close to Hezbollah, told Al Jazeera, referring to the 1989 pact designed to end the 15-year Lebanese Civil War. “The issue of confronting the Israeli enemy is one of the priorities.”

The partnership of Aoun and Salam signals a shift away from the traditional blocs of political power in Lebanon as well as the billionaire prime minister profile of some of Salam’s predecessors, including Saad Hariri and current caretaker Premier Mikati.

Many Lebanese said Salam’s designation as prime minister in particular is a boon for the country and its hopes at reforms.

“I am very hopeful,” said Dalal Mawad, a Lebanese journalist and author who counts Salam as a mentor. “He embodies the justice and accountability and the rule of law that we want to see in Lebanon.”

“What we can say is that Nawaf Salam’s nomination definitely augurs well for the future of Lebanon,” Bitar said. “Most Lebanese are optimistic for the first time in a couple of decades or at least for the first time since 2019.”

Salam’s name first began to be circulated for the premiership shortly after the mass protests that broke out on October 17, 2019. He is widely seen as someone who, despite being from a prominent political family – his relatives include former Prime Ministers Saeb Salam and Tammam Salam – is outside the traditional political oligarchy.

In his first speech as prime minister-designate, Salam spoke about building “a modern, civil and just state”.

He also spoke about achieving “justice, security, progress and opportunities”.

He spoke specifically of justice for the victims of the August 4, 2020, Beirut port blast and the 2019 bank crisis when depositors were suddenly stripped of access to their money and no officials or banks were held accountable.

Lebanese media reported on Tuesday that the investigation into the blast, which had been derailed by Lebanese political groups including Hezbollah, would resume shortly.

Despite the focus of many on Hezbollah, all of Lebanon’s most powerful parties have taken advantage of the system to avoid accountability or block political agendas they oppose.

The next challenge for Aoun and Salam will be to deliver on their statements as they confront a political system built on sectarianism.

Lebanon’s sectarian system “necessitates new approaches”, Majed said, adding that Lebanon was in need of a monopoly on violence by state institutions and weapons and “a strategy to defend Lebanon from real Israeli hostilities”.

Under the current sectarian system, Lebanon is managed by a handful of political parties and leaders with deeply rooted support and control over the state’s institutions. These leaders, who span Lebanon’s religious sects, are accused of using these resources and their political power to build their patronage networks, holding people accountable to them rather than the state.

These powers have become entrenched in their positions and resistant to change.

“We need to make fundamental, structural reforms in Lebanon to the political system, and I do not know if that is doable,” Hilal Khashan, a political scientist at the American University of Beirut and former colleague of Salam’s, told Al Jazeera.

Appointing strong or new leaders in positions of power is not all that is needed to root out the deeply entrenched corruption and clientelism. Salam, for example, is not the first technocrat to take a prominent role in Lebanon.

“The difference is that, in the past, technocrats came to power when the political class wanted to procrastinate,” Houry said. “They were never brought in with any legitimacy, which depended on the political class, so they didn’t have the capacity or support to put in place most of their reforms.”

But today, the myriad crises in Lebanon mean the political class understands it has to let some reforms happen – even if it will likely continue to oppose systemic changes.

Salam and Aoun will have to tackle questions of economic stability, security and national dialogue without isolating any community and while managing foreign relations, including Israeli aggression. The series of issues to address is long and arduous.

Analysts, however, said Salam and Aoun have a unique opportunity. The collapse of the al-Assad regime, a constant meddler in Lebanese affairs, the weakening of Iran and the willingness of the international community to provide foreign aid and backing to Lebanon’s new leaders mean there is support for a reform agenda that wasn’t previously there.

Even with positive conditions, confronting the deeply entrenched and resilient Lebanese political class will still be a back-breaking endeavour. Many analysts said that despite their positivity over Salam’s appointment, they held doubts about whether anyone could uproot the Lebanese political system.

Still, Khashan said, Salam “is the right man for the period”.

articles.title: Why is Israel attacking Lebanon’s Nabatieh, the major southern city?
articles.summary: Israel issued forced displacement for Lebanon’s southern city of Nabatieh on Tuesday. Why is it focused on this city?
articles.body:
Beirut, Lebanon – The Israeli military ordered the forced displacement of the population of Lebanon’s southern city of Nabatieh on Tuesday, amid an escalation of its campaign – ostensibly against Hezbollah targets – in Lebanon.

Israel hit towns on the outskirts of Nabatieh on Wednesday with “near continuous artillery shelling”, Al Jazeera’s Zeina Khodor reported, coming as Muslims in the country celebrated the religious holiday of Eid al-Adha.

Local media reported that Israel hit Nabatieh multiple times on Tuesday, including direct air strikes on a cemetery in the city limits. Israel also struck surrounding villages, with the village Yohmor al-Shaqif hit multiple times.

For its part, Hezbollah announced artillery and drone strikes on the advancing Israeli forces around the town of Zawtar al-Sharqiya, in the Nabatieh district.

Israel has killed at least 3,213 people in Lebanon, including paramedics and civilians, since it intensified its war on Lebanon on March 2, expanding its invasion and occupation of southern towns and villages.

Despite US President Donald Trump announcing another ceasefire on April 16, Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade attacks, while Israel has established an approximately 10km (six-mile) buffer zone whose northern periphery is marked by what Israel calls a “ yellow line .”

So why is Israel focusing so heavily on Nabatieh, one of the biggest cities in southern Lebanon?

Nabatieh is a city and a municipality in southern Lebanon that sits above the Litani River, and about 11km (seven miles) from the southern border.

The Litani has been a focal point of past ceasefire and international agreements, often stating that Hezbollah’s presence should retreat to the north of the Litani.

Surrounding Nabatieh city are a number of villages that have also been regularly attacked or destroyed by Israeli attacks.

The recent focus on Nabatieh is an effort to “transform it into one of the villages or cities included below the yellow line”, Jad Dilati, a political analyst from Nabatieh, told Al Jazeera.

Nabatieh is a historic symbol of resistance in Lebanon. Many locals point to the Ashura Uprising in 1983, when Israeli soldiers drove towards a crowd performing a religious ceremony in the city. The brigade tried to force its way through the procession but was met by tens of thousands of angry civilians.

The incident came in the early years of the Israeli occupation of southern Lebanon (1982-2000), which ended with Israeli expulsion and withdrawal.

“It is said that this [incident] was the spark that triggered radicalisation and a belief in armed resistance for the next 18 years,” Dilati said.

Nabatieh’s inhabitants are predominantly Shia Muslim, and the city is a crucial hub for south Lebanon’s economy. Israel’s war on Lebanon has not just been about killing Hezbollah fighters but also putting pressure on the Shia community, from which Hezbollah derives the majority of its support.

“I would see this targeting of Nabatieh as part of that overall strategy to essentially cripple the Shia community in Lebanon and one way to do that is by destroying different economic engines and the capacity of that community and one of the largest economic engines of the south is Nabatieh,” Mohamad Bazzi, a DAWN fellow, told Al Jazeera.

Dilati said Israel is targeting Nabatieh due to its status as an “administrative, economic, and symbolic heart of the south”. He said the idea is to hurt the Shia community as a means of forcing Hezbollah to end the war.

“They [hope they] can pressure Hezbollah to end the war by making the return [of people] impossible and by making everyday life impossible.”

⁠Israel’s Prime Minister ⁠Benjamin Netanyahu announced his military’s intention to “crush” Hezbollah. On Tuesday, Netanyahu said that the Israeli military had expanded its operations beyond the so-called “Yellow Line”.

“We are at war with Hezbollah, and we will intensify our strikes,” he said in a video released Monday on the messaging app Telegram.

His announcement led to an exodus of people from Beirut’s southern suburbs. Many had returned home since the ostensible ceasefire began due to a halting of attacks on Beirut.

While Israel says it is attacking Hezbollah targets, many civilians have also been killed. On Wednesday, Lebanon’s Civil Defence forces announced they had rescued 15 civilians in Nabatieh trapped inside damaged buildings.

Israel has also repeatedly targeted paramedics , sometimes in double or triple-tap strikes , and has killed at least 15 journalists, according to the Committee for the Protection of Journalists (CPJ).

The government is preparing for direct negotiations with Israel on June 2 and 3.

Addressing the nation on Eid al-Adha holiday, Lebanon’s President Joseph Aoun said that Lebanon needs “love, solidarity, and unity … in light of the difficult circumstances and challenges facing Lebanon, especially as a result of the continued Israeli attacks”.

The group said its fighters clashed with Israeli forces in Zawtar al-Sharqiya, in the Nabatieh district, at “point-blank range.”

On Sunday, Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem delivered a televised address denouncing upcoming direct negotiations between Lebanon’s government and Israel.

“Nabatieh has been repeatedly targeted since the 1978 invasion, 1982 occupation, in 1993 and in 1996, and in 2006, in 2024, and now,” Dilati said.

Nabatieh was attacked daily during Israel’s 2024 intensification, destroying the town’s historic souk . Even during the ceasefire period, Israel attacked both Nabatieh as a city, as well as the wider district.

During the latest intensification, which started on March 2, Israel has attacked Nabatieh and its surrounding areas repeatedly.

“Even before today, almost every area or province of Nabatieh has received an evacuation order,” Dilati said. Surrounding areas were already emptied by previous evacuation orders and intensive bombardment that destroyed significant segments of the city, he added.

How are the people of Nabatieh being affected?

More than 1.2 million people in Lebanon are displaced, including many from Nabatieh and the surrounding towns and villages.

Speaking shortly after the announcement of the ceasefire on April 16, one man from a village near Nabatieh who has been displaced to Beirut’s waterside, told Al Jazeera he would not return home until Parliament Speaker Nabih Berri announced it was safe.

In 2024, many in and around Nabatieh fled their homes. Locals said that many had stayed home during this latest intensification, either after what they said was indignity in 2024, during another mass displacement, or because they could no longer afford alternative housing.

“What the evacuation order for the entire city did was force whoever remained, whoever didn’t want to leave, to leave because they saw the intensity of the air strikes in the past few days, and the evacuation order instilled a sense of genuine fear in its residents who are now all displaced,” Dilati said. “And the city is now effectively empty, and the next goal is to destroy the city.”

images.caption: Smoke billows following an Israeli strike in Nabatieh, Lebanon May 26, 2026 [Stringer/Reuters]

articles.title: What is Lebanon’s Beaufort Castle, and why has Israel captured it?
articles.summary: The fortress, a historical battleground, is playing a central role in Israel’s military campaign against Hezbollah.
articles.body:
The Israeli military has captured Lebanon’s Beaufort Castle, a medieval hilltop fortress in the country’s south, amid an expanded military offensive against the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah.

The capture, announced on Sunday, comes amid fighting despite a “ceasefire” between Israel and Lebanon, which Israel has repeatedly violated.

“The Israeli flag is once again flying over the peaks overlooking the Galilee communities,” Defence Minister Israel Katz said at a memorial ceremony for fallen soldiers of the 1982 war with Lebanon, according to The Times of Israel newspaper.

“Our heroic soldiers have captured Beaufort once again and will remain there as part of the security zone in Lebanon,” he was quoted as saying.

Katz circulated a photo on social media of the castle with the Israeli flag and also that of the military’s Golani Brigade.

So what is Beaufort Castle, how did Israel capture it and why does it matter?

Beaufort Castle, known in Arabic as Qalaat al-Shaqif, is a 900-year-old fortress located on a rocky hilltop in southern Lebanon, about 700 metres (2,300ft) above sea level. Built during the 12th century by Crusaders, the castle overlooks the Litani River.

The Crusaders named the castle Beaufort, which means “beautiful fortress” in Old French.

Over the centuries, the fortress has changed hands multiple times, passing from Crusader rulers to various regional powers, including the Ottoman Empire. Historically, its elevated position made it one of the most important defensive strongholds in the region, allowing whoever controlled it to monitor movement across a large area of southern Lebanon.

In more recent years, Palestinian fighters used the site as a base before Israel captured it during its 1982 invasion of Lebanon. Israeli forces then occupied the castle as part of their security zone in southern Lebanon until withdrawing from the area in 2000.

What is the strategic significance of Beaufort Castle?

Sitting atop a strategic hill near Nabatieh, Lebanon’s fifth largest city, Beaufort Castle and the surrounding ridge, which Israeli forces have also secured, is regarded as one of southern Lebanon’s most strategically important military positions.

The capture of the castle offers Israeli troops an observation point over a large part of southern Lebanon and northern Israel.

Israeli officials said the operation was aimed at dismantling Hezbollah infrastructure and securing high ground close to the Israeli border.

Al Jazeera’s Obaida Hitto, reporting from Tyre in southern Lebanon, said the capture of the castle gives the Israeli forces “a significant tactical advantage against Hezbollah”.

“It overlooks all of the towns and villages that are around the city of Nabatieh. It also looks over the western Bekaa Valley, all the way into the occupied Golan Heights and into northern Galilee,” he reported.

“People here are extremely concerned that this operation is going to expand even more because of the vantage point that the Israelis now have.”

What is happening in southern Lebanon now?

According to the latest figures from the Lebanese Ministry of Public Health, more than 3,412 people have been killed and 10,269 wounded in Israeli attacks on the country since March 2.

Israeli forces captured Beaufort Castle after days of fighting and air strikes in villages surrounding the fortress. Troops advanced through the rugged terrain near Nabatieh, where clashes with Hezbollah fighters had been taking place.

Israeli forces killed at least 12 people and wounded 35 in more than 36 attacks across southern Lebanon on Sunday alone, according to an Al Jazeera tally.

Israel has already occupied large swaths of southern Lebanon since fighting escalated after the US-Israel war on Iran began on February 28. Israeli forces now occupy about 2,000sq km (770sq miles) of Lebanese territory – nearly one-fifth of the country.

Iran-backed Hezbollah entered the war by launching rockets, missiles and drones towards a missile defence site near Haifa in northern Israel on March 2 in response to the killing of Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei in the war’s first strike on Tehran.

Until then, the Iran-backed group had not attacked Israel since a November 2024 ceasefire was announced, despite near-daily breaches of the agreement by Israel.

Last week, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered an even deeper military operation into Lebanon, marking Israel’s farthest invasion into its northern neighbour in more than a quarter of a century.

On Sunday, Netanyahu said he again “instructed the Israeli military to expand the manoeuvre in Lebanon”.

“Now my instruction is to deepen and expand our grip on the places that were under Hezbollah’s control,” he said during a visit to the front lines.

On Monday, Israel issued a forced displacement order to residents of seven villages in southern Lebanon, including Houmine al-Faouqa, Bnaafoul, Arab Salim, Roumine, Aazze, Arkey and Jbaa.

The army’s Arabic language spokesperson, Avichay Adraee, announced in a post on X that residents must move away immediately from the affected area by 1,000 metres (3,280 feet) as Israel plans to attack.

articles.title: Carro bate em poste, derruba fio e morador morre eletrocutado em casa | G1
articles.standfirst: O acidente aconteceu na localidade de Albuquerque, em Aracati. A Polícia Civil investiga o caso.
articles.summary: O acidente aconteceu na localidade de Albuquerque, em Aracati. A Polícia Civil investiga o caso.
articles.body:
Carro bate em poste, derruba fio e morador morre eletrocutado dentro de casa, no Ceará. — Foto: Reprodução

Um homem de 61 anos morreu eletrocutado dentro de casa, na madrugada deste domingo (6), em Aracati , no litoral do Ceará. A vítima esbarrou em fio da rede elétrica que caiu na casa dele após um carro bater em um poste. O caso aconteceu na localidade de Sítio Albuquerque, zona rural do município.

O homem, ainda não identificado, estava dormindo quando se assustou com o barulho causado pelo carro que bateu no poste. Ele levantou para conferir o que tinha acontecido, mas não viu o fio na residência. Ele esbarrou no fio que estava energizado e morreu no local.

Não há informações sobre o estado de saúde do motorista do carro ou da causa do acidente.

Em nota, a Polícia Civil do Ceará informou que apura as circunstâncias da morte. Equipes da Polícia Militar e da Perícia Forense do Ceará (Pefoce) foram acionadas para a ocorrência.

A Delegacia de Polícia Civil de Aracati está a cargo dos trabalhos investigativos com o intuito de elucidar o caso, bem como aguarda o laudo pericial para confirmar a causa da morte.

A Enel Distribuição Ceará informou que foi acionada e realizou as intervenções necessárias para garantir a segurança no local, reparar a rede elétrica e normalizar o fornecimento de energia na área afetada.

"A Enel lamenta profundamente o ocorrido e manifesta sua solidariedade aos familiares . A companhia permanece à disposição das autoridades para prestar os esclarecimentos necessários", disse a empresa.

articles.body:
INMET emite alerta de 'tempestade' para 129 cidades do Norte, Centro e Noroeste de MG — Foto: Inmet

O Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia ( Inmet ) emitiu, na manhã desta sexta-feira (12), um alerta amarelo de “tempestade” para 129 cidades das regiões Norte, Centro e Noroeste de Minas Gerais

O aviso, classificado como “Perigo potencial”, indica previsão de chuva entre 20 e 30 mm por hora ou 50 mm por dia, com ventos intensos (40 a 60km/h) e queda de granizo.

O alerta começou a valer às 11h deste domingo (6) e segue até as 23h59.

O instituto recomenda que a população evite sair de casa durante o temporal, não enfrente áreas alagadas, e, em casos de rajadas de vento, evitar buscar abrigo debaixo de árvores, pois há risco de queda e descargas elétricas..

articles.title: Can AfD form Germany’s first far-right state government since World War II?
articles.summary: Germany’s far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) is projected to win a regional election in Saxony-Anhalt.
articles.body:
Can AfD form Germany’s first far-right state government since World War II?

Germany’s far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) is projected to win a regional election in Saxony-Anhalt with around 44 per cent of the vote, more than double its result five years ago. However, the party faces an uphill battle to form a state government, as other major parties have ruled out working with it.

articles.summary: Adolescente foi encontrado por mergulhadores do Corpo de Bombeiros após buscas iniciadas no sábado (5), em Itapecuru-Mirim.
articles.body:
Corpo de adolescente de 15 anos é encontrado após afogamento no Rio Itapecuru, no Maranhão — Foto: Divulgação/ Corpo de Bombeiros

O Corpo de Bombeiros Militar do Maranhão encontrou, na manhã deste domingo (6), o corpo de um adolescente de 15 anos que desapareceu após se afogar no Rio Itapecuru, em Itapecuru-Mirim, no Maranhão.

A vítima foi identificada como Luís Gustavo Costa Sousa. Segundo relatos de testemunhas, o adolescente estava no rio acompanhado de outros jovens quando teria se afogado ao tentar atravessar o local.

O Corpo de Bombeiros foi acionado por volta das 14h54 de sábado (5) e iniciou as buscas ainda durante a tarde. Os trabalhos seguiram até o início da noite e foram retomados na manhã deste domingo.

As equipes do 11º Batalhão de Bombeiros Militar e do Batalhão de Bombeiros Marítimo (BBMar) participaram das buscas pelo adolescente.

Por volta das 9h43, mergulhadores do Corpo de Bombeiros localizaram o corpo da vítima nas proximidades do ponto indicado por testemunhas como o local onde ocorreu o afogamento.

Após a localização, o corpo foi retirado do rio e os procedimentos necessários foram realizados pelas equipes responsáveis.

Em nota publicada nas redes sociais, o Corpo de Bombeiros Militar do Maranhão lamentou a morte do adolescente e manifestou solidariedade aos familiares e amigos de Luís Gustavo Costa Sousa.

A corporação reforçou a importância de cuidados durante atividades em rios, principalmente em áreas de correnteza ou sem supervisão adequada, para evitar novos acidentes.

articles.title: Carro pega fogo perto de bomba de combustível em posto no Piauí | G1
articles.standfirst: Incêndio aconteceu em Esperantina, no Norte do estado; bomba de abastecimento e parte do teto ficaram completamente destruídos.
articles.summary: Incêndio aconteceu em Esperantina, no Norte do estado; bomba de abastecimento e parte do teto ficaram completamente destruídos.
articles.body:
Um carro pegou fogo no início da tarde deste domingo (6) em um posto de combustíveis em Esperantina , no Norte do Piauí. O veículo estava a cerca de um metro de uma bomba de abastecimento , que ficou completamente destruída pelas chamas. Ninguém ficou ferido.

Segundo o Corpo de Bombeiros, o incêndio teria começado quando o motorista abastecia o veículo e o frentista percebeu que saía fumaça da região do motor. Parte do teto e da estrutura do estabelecimento também foi danificada.

No entanto, segundo o proprietário do Posto Santo Expedito, Chico Zeca, o carro chegou ao local já soltando fumaça.

"O fogo começou do carro. O carro chegou fumaçando. Meu frentista não chegou nem a ativar a bomba para abastecer, foi verificar a fumaça do carro dele, aí logo em seguida já começou a combustão, o fogo", contou o proprietário ao g1 .

Foram utilizados aproximadamente 1.500 litros de água. O fogo foi controlado rapidamente e não se espalhou para outras áreas do estabelecimento.

O motorista já estava fora do veículo quando as chamas começaram e não ficou ferido. Ainda não há informações sobre o que teria causado o incêndio .

articles.title: Áudio em que nº 3 da Fazenda de SP fala em comprar sauna para lavar dinheiro foi gravado por 'Rei Artur' | G1
articles.standfirst: Áudio foi feito pelo próprio auditor Artur Gomes da Silva Neto durante almoço com fiscais em 2023 e acabou apreendido na Operação Ícaro; André Weiss também fala em 'rateio' e teme ser preso caso ostentasse riqueza.
articles.summary: Áudio foi feito pelo próprio auditor Artur Gomes da Silva Neto durante almoço com fiscais em 2023 e acabou apreendido na Operação Ícaro; André Weiss também fala em 'rateio' e teme ser preso caso ostentasse riqueza.
articles.body:
O auditor fiscal Artur Gomes da Silva Neto, o “Rei Artur”, apontado pelo Ministério Público de São Paulo (MP-SP) como um dos principais operadores do esquema bilionário de corrupção na Secretaria da Fazenda, foi o responsável por gravar o almoço em que André Weiss, então diretor de Fiscalização da pasta, falou em comprar uma sauna para lavar dinheiro .

A gravação foi feita em 27 de julho de 2023, pelo próprio Artur, que participava da conversa, e permaneceu armazenada em seu celular. Dois anos depois, o aparelho foi apreendido na Operação Ícaro, e o arquivo acabou se tornando uma das provas usadas pelo Ministério Público nos desdobramentos da investigação, que culminou na prisão de Weiss .

O documento do MP-SP afirma expressamente que o áudio foi localizado no telefone de Artur e que a gravação havia sido feita pelo próprio fiscal, sem conhecimento dos demais participantes. O arquivo foi posteriormente submetido a perícia do Núcleo de Computação Forense do Centro de Apoio Operacional à Execução (Caex), que verificou sua autenticidade e integridade.

Na época, Weiss dirigia a Diretoria de Fiscalização, enquanto Artur havia exercido a função de supervisor fiscal da mesma diretoria.

Durante o encontro, os fiscais discutiram processos de ressarcimento de ICMS envolvendo grandes empresas, segundo o Ministério Público.

Em determinado momento, Artur relata aos colegas que um ex-delegado tributário teria dito que começaria a “gravar tudo” para não “cair sozinho”. Enquanto contava a história, porém, era o próprio Artur quem registrava escondido a conversa à mesa.

Para o MP, a fala fazia referência à divisão de valores relacionados aos processos discutidos pelo grupo.

Em outro trecho, Artur também fala sobre sua participação em valores relacionados a um procedimento de ressarcimento. Segundo a transcrição, ele afirma que um operador externo responsável pelo trabalho separaria “uma parte que ele tinha combinado” com o fiscal.

Andre Weiss (esquerda) e o advogado João Buttini — Foto: Reprodução

É nessa mesma gravação que Weiss passa a falar sobre a possibilidade de adquirir uma sauna em São Paulo.

Segundo a transcrição apresentada pelo MP-SP, ele afirma:

“Você sabe que eu pensei em pegar dinheiro e comprar uma sauna em São Paulo... pra fazer reunião... vamos juntar uma grana e vamos pegar uma porra de uma sauna, né? E para lavar também é bom.”

Na sequência, Weiss argumenta que um estabelecimento do tipo facilitaria a circulação de dinheiro em espécie:

“Quantas pessoas entram em sauna e pagam em dinheiro? Quase todas, cara. Pô, quem que vai passar um cartão em sauna? Ninguém.”

Para os promotores, Weiss descrevia em primeira pessoa uma possível estratégia de lavagem por meio de um estabelecimento com intensa movimentação de dinheiro vivo. Os autos não indicam que a compra tenha sido concretizada.

Na mesma conversa, Weiss demonstra preocupação com a possibilidade de chamar atenção caso exibisse sinais externos de riqueza. Ele menciona uma Mercedes de R$ 250 mil e diz que a aquisição poderia levá-lo aos jornais e terminar com sua prisão.

O áudio foi gravado menos de um mês antes da primeira entrega de propina relatada por Paulo Prado em seu acordo de colaboração premiada. Segundo Prado, a partir de meados de 2023 passou a pagar R$ 250 mil por mês a Weiss para permanecer à frente da Delegacia Regional Tributária do Butantã.

Artur foi preso na Operação Ícaro, deflagrada em agosto de 2025 . As buscas realizadas contra ele e a análise de seus aparelhos eletrônicos revelaram, segundo o Ministério Público, que o esquema investigado era maior do que a frente inicialmente relacionada à Fast Shop e à Ultrafarma.

Os investigadores encontraram, por exemplo, 15 mensagens entre o e-mail pessoal de Artur e advogados do escritório Buttini, além de reuniões pelo Microsoft Teams e conversas por WhatsApp.

O MP-SP afirma que o material extraído dos aparelhos de Artur e Paulo Prado, juntamente com a delação, documentos manuscritos, movimentações financeiras e a gravação do almoço, passou a sustentar as novas fases da investigação.

O g1 procurou as defesas de André Weiss e dos demais investigados citados, além da Secretaria da Fazenda, e aguarda retorno.

"Desde a deflagração da Operação Ícaro, em agosto de 2025, a Secretaria da Fazenda e Planejamento atua em conjunto com o Ministério Público de São Paulo na apuração rigorosa dos fatos. As ações da pasta resultaram na demissão de cinco envolvidos, além de um exonerado e 17 servidores afastados sem remuneração.

As empresas envolvidas também estão sendo responsabilizadas, com autuações específicas que já resultaram na constituição de mais de R$ 3 bilhões em créditos tributários, multas e juros.

Qualquer novo fato decorrente dos desdobramentos da operação, inclusive de eventuais acordos de delação ou denúncias, será rigorosamente apurado e, comprovadas irregularidades, serão adotadas as medidas cabíveis.

A Secretaria colabora integralmente com as investigações e reafirma seu compromisso com a rigorosa apuração e responsabilização de eventuais desvios, sem qualquer tolerância com condutas irregulares."

Pedestres enfrentam frio e garoa na Avenida Paulista — Foto: GABRIEL SILVA/RASPRESS/ESTADÃO CONTEÚDO

Os dados disponíveis na estação, que fica na Zona Norte da capital, mostram que às 6h, a máxima daquele momento chegou a 12,9°C. Na sequência, houve uma leve recuperação, com o registro de 13,5°C ao meio-dia. A partir daí, voltou a esfriar: às 14h, a máxima horária era de 12,6°C, e, às 17h, 12,1°C

articles.title: Mais de 90% da chuva de agosto caiu em apenas dois dias em Rio Branco | G1
articles.standfirst: Capital acumulou 48,1 milímetros no mês, mantendo média 3% acima do previsto, mas agosto passou 25 dias sem qualquer registro de precipitação. Distribuição irregular não muda cenário de estiagem.
articles.summary: Capital acumulou 48,1 milímetros no mês, mantendo média 3% acima do previsto, mas agosto passou 25 dias sem qualquer registro de precipitação.
articles.body:
Em agosto, foram registrados 48,1 milímetros de chuva em Rio Branco , cerca de 3,4% a mais do volume previsto para o mês, que era de 46,5 milímetros. 48,1 milímetros de chuva em Rio Branco, cerca de 3,4% a mais do volume previsto para o mês, que era de 46,5 milímetros .

Contudo, segundo a Defesa Civil Municipal, apesar de ter ultrapassado o previsto, a chuva ficou concentrada em poucos dias: 25 dos 31 dias não tiveram registro de precipitação .

Dos seis dias em que choveu, dois somaram 44 milímetros , cerca de 91% de toda a chuva registrada no mês. Conforme o levantamento da Defesa Civil, em um deles choveu 16 milímetros e, no outro, 28 milímetros.

O acumulado de agosto deste ano, no entanto, foi quase quatro vezes maior que o registrado no mesmo mês de 2025, quando Rio Branco teve 12,2 milímetros de chuva, equivalente a 26% do volume esperado. ( Confira, mais abaixo, a série histórica de janeiro a agosto deste ano )

👉 Naquele período, a capital acreana também enfrentava uma das fases mais secas do ano, com o Rio Acre abaixo dos dois metros.

Ao g1 , o coordenador da Defesa Civil de Rio Branco, tenente-coronel Cláudio Falcão, explicou que o acumulado de agosto não representa uma mudança no cenário de estiagem porque a chuva não ocorreu de forma regular.

“Agosto teve esses 48 milímetros de chuva. A gente esperava 46,5 milímetros, mas é bom lembrar que só choveu seis dias do mês. Em dois desses dias foi praticamente toda a chuva do mês”, salientou.

A concentração das precipitações também foi observada ao longo do primeiro semestre deste ano. Entre janeiro e junho, Rio Branco acumulou 1.557,5 milímetros, 18% a mais que os 1.321,2 milímetros registrados no mesmo período de 2025.

O volume maior, no entanto, também foi influenciado por episódios isolados. Em junho, por exemplo, a capital acumulou 106 milímetros, mas 103 milímetros caíram em apenas um dia. Sem essa chuva, o mês teria terminado com aproximadamente 3 milímetros.

Com 48,1 mm acumulados, Rio Branco registra mais de 103% da chuva prevista para agosto — Foto: Rafaela Rodrigues/Arquivo pessoal

Para setembro, a Defesa Civil Municipal prevê 92,7 milímetros de chuva , quase o dobro do volume esperado para agosto.

Mesmo assim, Falcão afirma que o cenário de estiagem deve continuar, já que a previsão indica que as chuvas podem ocorrer de maneira irregular.

“É difícil chover e, se chover, vai ser de maneira irregular, e infelizmente isso não resolve o problema da seca, que deve continuar. Isso porque o volume de chuva previsto para o mês, sozinho, não garante uma melhora nas condições hídricas da capital. A frequência e a distribuição das precipitações também são importantes”, afirmou.

Enquanto agosto terminou com chuva acima do esperado no acumulado, o Rio Acre continua em nível baixo em Rio Branco.

Segundo a Defesa Civil Municipal, o manancial marcou 1,59 metro neste domingo (6), a menor marca deste ano até então. A medição ocorre poucos dias depois de o rio atingir 1,83 metro, no dia 31 de agosto e ficar abaixo dos 2 metros pela 3ª vez este ano.

O baixo nível também é reflexo da falta de chuvas na capital. Falcão explica ainda que as oscilações registradas no manancial nas últimas semanas não significam necessariamente uma melhora na situação hídrica da capital.

“Essa água que aumenta o nível do rio nunca é daqui. Ela é de outros municípios. Então, o cenário não muda. Mesmo a gente tendo chuva dentro do esperado para agosto”, completou.

Rio Acre está abaixo dos 2 metros em Rio Branco — Foto: Richard Lauriano/Rede Amazônica Acre

Além da falta de chuvas regulares, as altas temperaturas aumentam a pressão sobre os rios e o solo. Segundo Falcão, o calor favorece a evaporação e contribui para manter a região mais seca. A previsão de chuvas abaixo da média se estende por setembro, outubro, novembro e dezembro.

Com menos chuva e temperaturas elevadas, a tendência é de maior perda de água do solo e dos mananciais.

O cenário também ocorre sob a possibilidade de influência do El Niño, fenômeno climático associado ao aquecimento anormal das águas do Pacífico Equatorial e que pode alterar o regime de chuvas e temperaturas em diferentes regiões do país.

Para a região Norte, historicamente, o fenômeno está relacionado a períodos mais secos e quentes. O calor intenso, por sua vez, agrava os efeitos da estiagem.

articles.title: ES recebe alertas de queda de temperatura e tempestade; veja lista | G1
articles.standfirst: Feriado do Dia da Independência do Brasil será marcado pela atuação de uma frente fria, que vai causar chuva na maior parte do estado.
articles.summary: Feriado do Dia da Independência do Brasil será marcado pela atuação de uma frente fria, que vai causar chuva na maior parte do estado.
articles.body:
Inmet emitiu três alertas amarelos para o Espírito Santo — Foto: Reprodução/Inmet

O feriado do Dia da Independência do Brasil, nesta segunda-feira (7), será marcado por frio e chuva em grande parte do Espírito Santo. O Instituto Nacional de Meteorologia emitiu três alertas amarelos para o estado , que indicam perigo potencial de declínio de temperatura, tempestade e ventos costeiros .

Segundo o Instituto Capixaba de Pesquisa, Assistência Técnica e Extensão Rural (Incaper), o cenário é resultado da influência da frente fria posicionada entre o sul da Bahia e o Espírito Santo, que favorece o transporte de umidade do oceano em direção ao continente.

Com isso, ainda de acordo com o Incaper, há previsão de chuva em todo o litoral capixaba, além das regiões Sul, Serrana e do extremo Norte do estado. Nas demais áreas, especialmente no Noroeste capixaba, o céu permanece com muitas nuvens, mas sem previsão de chuva.

As temperaturas seguem amenas em todo o território capixaba, em razão da atuação da massa de ar mais fria associada ao sistema frontal.

O primeiro alerta, de declínio de temperatura , teve início à meia noite deste domingo (6) e será válido até as 12h de segunda-feira (7). Nas cidades listadas, há possibilidade de queda de 3ºC e 5ºC nas máximas. Veja os municípios em alerta:

O segundo alerta, de perigo potencial de tempestade , prevê chuva entre 20 e 30 milímetros por hora ou até 50 milímetros por dia, além de ventos intensos entre 40 e 60 km/h e queda de granizo. Segundo o instituto, é baixo risco de corte de energia elétrica, estragos em plantações, queda de galhos de árvores e de alagamentos. O alerta é válido durante toda a segunda-feira. Veja os municípios em alerta:

O terceiro alerta, de perigo potencial para ventos costeiros , indica a intensificação dos ventos nas regiões litorâneas, movimentando dunas de areia sobre construções na orla. O aviso é válido até o final da manhã desta segunda-feira. Veja as cidades em alerta:

articles.title: VÍDEO: Serra do RS registra neve neste domingo | G1
articles.standfirst: Fenômeno ocorreu em São José dos Ausentes, nos Campos de Cima da Serra, município que registrou temperatura de 3,8ºC.
articles.summary: Fenômeno ocorreu em São José dos Ausentes, nos Campos de Cima da Serra, município que registrou temperatura de 3,8ºC.
articles.body:
Nevou sobre os Campos de Cima da Serra, no Rio Grande do Sul, na tarde deste domingo (6). O fenômeno foi registrado por turistas e moradores por volta das 15h, quando os termômetros marcavam 3,8ºC no município de São José dos Ausentes .

Turistas que praticavam cavalgadas no município registraram imagens em vídeos (veja acima) . Moradores de fazendas da região também gravar o fenômeno, que foi confirmado pela Climatempo Meteorologia.

Também teve neve na cidade vizinha, em Cambará do Sul . Flocos caíram na localidade de Azulega. Ambos municípios fazem divisa com Santa Catarina.

Inicialmente, o fenômeno foi tratado como uma precipitação invernal, pois não era possível determinar se era neve ou chuva congelada — ou se era chuva congelada e neve ao mesmo tempo. Depois, foi constatado que se trata, de fato, de neve. Já em São Francisco de Paula e em Gramado , houve chuva congelada e/ou graupel.

❄️ Precipitação invernal é qualquer forma de água que cai da atmosfera no inverno, geralmente associada a temperaturas baixas. Pode incluir: neve (cristais de gelo que caem em flocos), granizo ou graupel (bolas de gelo) e chuva congelante (chuva líquida que congela ao tocar superfícies frias).

Ainda há a chance de voltar a nevar na Serra Gaúcha ainda na noite deste domingo (6).

"As precipitações invernais na Serra Gaúcha ocorreram até um pouco antes do esperado, durante a tardem e não à noite. Mas ainda podem ocorrer na noite de hoje. A tendência é de diminuição da nebulosidade no decorrer da madrugada da segunda-feira (7) e o dia deve amanhecer com muita geada, com temperaturas negativas", afirma a meteorologista Josélia Pegorim, da Climatempo Meteorologia.

Caiu neve também no Cânion Fortaleza, que fica na região de Cambará do Sul, onde turistas inclusive conseguiram fazer um boneco de neve no local. (Veja na foto abaixo)

Um dos vídeos da neve foi gravado pelo gaúcho Alexandre Pereira, que é proprietário de uma pousada Fazenda Monte Negro, localizada próximo ao Pico do Monte Negro, o ponto mais alto do estado. Segundo ele, não é comum nevar no local em setembro.

"Viemos fazer uma cavalgada com os turistas da pousada e a neve nos presenteou. São pessoas aqui do RS e de SC. O pessoal adorou. A gente é natutal daqui, acostumado com isso, mas esse ano veio fora de época", comenta.

"Temos uma família que nos visita na fazenda há 15 anos e a única coisa que faltava para eles era a neve ", celebra Alexandre.

Ao todo, 78 apostas acertaram cinco dezenas e receberam o mesmo valor de R$ 30.145,38. Outras 5.268 apostas acertaram quatro números, com prêmio de R$ 735,73 cada.

articles.title: Army combat veteran challenging Mike Lawler calls Hegseth national security 'hazard,' backs impeachment
articles.summary: Cait Conley, a 16-year Army veteran challenging Rep. Mike Lawler, says she would vote for articles of impeachment against Pete Hegseth at the Pentagon.
articles.body: Democratic congressional candidate Cait Conley, a 16-year Army combat veteran challenging Republican Rep. Mike Lawler in New York's 17th Congressional District, said Sunday on CNN's "State of the Union" that she would support impeaching War Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of endangering U.S. national security. Anchor Dana Bash asked Conley whether, if elected to Congress, she would support removing Hegseth from office amid recent scrutiny of his leadership at the Pentagon. "I believe he has been a hazard to American national security and a disgrace to the office," Conley said. "I would absolutely support removing him from office because his actions and decisions are failing service members who have sworn an oath to this country and deserve respect." DEM CANDIDATE CLEARS CROWDED FIELD TO FACE TRUMP-BACKED INCUMBENT IN NY Bash pressed Conley to clarify whether "removing" Hegseth meant she would actually vote for articles of impeachment against the Pentagon chief. "Against Pete Hegseth for his failure to protect America? Yes," Conley replied. Lawler campaign manager Ciro Riccardi seized on the impeachment declaration in a statement to Fox News Digital on Sunday, linking it to his campaign’s broader criticism of Conley following her appearance on CNN. "Cait Conley’s refusal to disavow Zohran Mamdani and the DSA is disqualifying. She is just as extreme as the rest and that was exposed today for all to see, including embracing impeachment," Riccardi said. TRUMP RETALIATES AFTER IRAN ATTACK AS EXPERT WARNS REGIME IS GROWING MORE DANGEROUS Conley's declaration came months after House Democrats formally introduced six articles of impeachment against Hegseth, accusing him of high crimes and misdemeanors over his handling of the Iran war, military strikes on alleged drug vessels, his use of Signal to discuss military operations, congressional oversight and other matters. Pentagon press secretary Kingsley Wilson dismissed that effort in an April statement to Fox News Digital and said Hegseth would remain focused on the department’s mission. "This is just another Democrat trying to make headlines as the Department of War decisively and overwhelmingly achieved the president's objectives in Iran," Wilson said. "Secretary Hegseth will continue to protect the homeland and project peace through strength. This is just another charade in an attempt to distract the American people from the major successes we have had here at the Department of War." Hegseth has also rejected previous waves of criticism surrounding his leadership. Amid calls for his removal following scrutiny of his use of Signal in 2025, Hegseth accused critics and the media of relying on disgruntled former employees to damage his reputation. HEGSETH TURNS TABLES ON DEMS AS SPARKS FLY DURING HEARING CLASH: 'I PUT THIS ON YOU' "This is what the media does. They take anonymous sources from disgruntled former employees, and then they try to slash and burn people and ruin their reputations," Hegseth said at the time. "It’s not going to work with me." Pressure on Hegseth has more recently crossed party lines. Outgoing Sen. Thom Tillis, R-N.C., called on President Donald Trump last week to replace Hegseth following Army Secretary Dan Driscoll's resignation. "I urge the President to find a new leader at the Pentagon who will retain and empower our military talent rather than diminish it," Tillis said. CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE OF MEDIA AND CULTURE The White House pushed back on Tillis’ criticism in a statement to Fox News Digital, saying Trump remained firmly behind Hegseth. "The President has complete trust in Secretary Hegseth, who is doing an incredible job leading the Pentagon," White House spokeswoman Anna Kelly said. Driscoll’s departure followed reported tensions with Hegseth over Army leadership and modernization. A source familiar with the situation told Fox News Digital that Driscoll had raised concerns about Hegseth blocking Army transformation efforts by removing generals involved in them. Driscoll, however, publicly praised Hegseth upon leaving office, saying the Army’s progress would not have been possible without his support. articles.title: Five dead after Amazon-branded cargo plane overruns runway at Miami airport, striking multiple vehicles
articles.summary: Multiple people were also taken to hospitals with unknown injuries, the Miami-Dade Sheriff’s Office said.
articles.body: Five people are dead and five others were injured when an Amazon-branded cargo plane crashed just outside Miami International Airport on Sunday afternoon, officials said. The Boeing 767-300 cargo aircraft overran the runway just before 2 p.m. ET while it was landing, according to officials. The plane, 21 Air Flight 7598, was arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, the Federal Aviation Administration said. The plane overran runway number 30, struck multiple vehicles, and came to rest at a field next to the airport, Miami-Dade County Sheriff Rosie Cordero-Stutz said. Three people are in critical condition and were taken to a trauma center, and two others were taken to a local hospital, Miami-Dade Fire Chief Raied Jadallah said. A hotline has been set up for family members who may have been involved in the tragedy. The scene remains active. Video showed plumes of smoke billowing from the wreckage. Multiple vehicles near the airport were struck, according to Miami-Dade Fire Rescue. Amazon spokesperson Kelly Nantel said the flight was operated by 21 Air and was attempting to land when the incident occurred. “We’re heartbroken to learn that five people lost their lives in today’s incident at Miami International Airport. Our deepest sympathies go out to the families, loved ones, and all those affected by this devastating loss,” Nantel said. “This is a fast-moving situation and we’re still gathering details. We’re working closely with local authorities and officials to understand exactly what happened,” she said. “Right now, our absolute priority is the safety, well-being, and care of everyone involved.” All runways and taxiways at Miami International Airport were closed following a ground stop, an airport spokesperson said in a statement. After 5 p.m. ET, two of the four runways at the airport had reopened, the airport spokesperson said, and the airport was under a ground delay. Fire and rescue personnel responded to the scene “within seconds,” said Miami-Dade County Mayor Daniella Levine Cava. More than 60 Miami-Dade Fire Rescue units responded to the scene, where firefighters worked to extinguish a “very complex fire” that involved blazing engine compartments, said Jadallah, the fire chief. A search and rescue operation was also launched to retrieve the pilot and co-pilot, trapped in the plane, he said. The plane struck “a couple of vehicles,” leaving some victims trapped inside and prompting a “a complex extrication” by a technical rescue team, Jadallah said. The National Transportation Safety Board said it is gathering information. The FAA and NTSB will determine the cause of the crash. The NTSB said it has launched a team to investigate the incident.

articles.title: On Martha’s Vineyard, buyers can pay up to $650,000 for a ‘beach key’ that comes with ownership of a tiny piece of non-buildable beachfront and access to a private beach
articles.summary: News News: Spending half a million dollars on a house makes sense. So does dropping that on a condo or an investment property. But what if it's used for a ‘beach.
articles.body: Spending half a million dollars on a house makes sense. So does dropping that on a condo or an investment property. But what if it's used for a ‘beach key’? On Martha's Vineyard, an island off the south coast of Massachusetts, people are laying down $650,000, but not for the love of the vineyard. Not for land they can build on. Not even for a home to live in, but for ‘access’. In this strangest real estate market, the commodity isn't square footage or ocean views, but access itself. On this island, half a million can buy you a physical key that opens a gate to a private beach! Those keys separate the island's most private shores from the crush of summer tourists. These tiny beach lots, often passed down through families for decades, are now up for sale! Regardless of how strange this commodity is, there has been a steep climb in prices and demand. For most, the purchase is less about the beach and more about what money can buy: exclusive access. This access can cost $400,000 or more.What owning a private beach meansTyler Smith, a retired architect, told Realtor.com what owning a beach key really means. He recalls bringing his now-adult kids when they were young. During the summers, it was a place for them to have some quality time. “We used to spend all day here, swimming and riding the surf," he recalled. Now, at 84, he and his brother are listing their 46-acre property for $16 million. Interestingly, his beach key alone is likely worth between $450,000 and $475,000. His brother, on the other hand, is keeping his own key for now, a detail that speaks volumes about what these little rectangles of metal mean on an island where oceanfront land is no longer a luxury but an heirloom.Beach keys come at a cost‘Beach keys’ have become the ultimate status symbol for the ultra-rich. Getting access to secluded stretches of sand that are off-limits to the masses is the kind of investment they seek. The keys come with ownership of a sliver of non-buildable beachfront. This access is often passed down through the generations, but each year, a handful of them are on sale. The prices for these keys have surged over the years, thanks to wealthy buyers who crave privacy, even though the popularity of the island is building.The mathematics of Martha's Vineyard beach keys can make your head spin. In 2003, entry to Quansoo Beach cost $200,000, according to Abby Rabinovitz of Tea Lane Associates. Last year, a key to the same beach sold for $475,000. A nearby option at Hancock Beach? $650,000. Well, this upward climb says a lot. “There’s more demand than supply. Prices reflect that,” Tea Lane’s Alexis Holden told the outlet. According to Holden, two clients even waited for ‘well over a year’ for the opportunity to buy a Chilmark beach key.Most of these exclusive beach keys come with their own rules, etiquette and policing mechanisms. Some associations issue new keys each summer to limit circulation. Others rely on keyholders to self-police, though locals all seem to have stories about overbearing owners who've confronted trespassers with unnecessary aggression. Black Point maintains a warden and a handyman to enforce order.There is, of course, more demand than supply, and prices have shot up as wealthy buyers realise that privacy comes with a price tag. One that helps them get past the crowded public beaches and clogged parking lots. At a time when homes on the island sell for $20 million routinely, a beach key worth $600,000 is really a small expense for elite buyers.But for locals, it's a different story. Property value on the island is rising. For instance, a Herring Creek Farm home was recently sold for $43 million. This means beach keys are out of reach for locals, and it has irked some: wealthy keyholders keeping the island’s best beaches to themselves isn’t exactly their vision.Mike Peters, a retired National Grid worker from Albany, N.Y., has been renting a place on Martha’s Vineyard since the 1990s. Every summer, he rents it out, and has never been able to afford to buy a place or beach key. “For the common people, you just visit and go home. You can’t own a piece of it.”The exclusivity of these keys has bred resentment. Residents and those who rent the property for the summer cannot afford them, yet watch wealthy second-home owners purchase a piece of Martha's Vineyard's most precious resource and wall it off. But this emotion is not only exclusive to the locals. In fact, some beach keyholders, too, feel the same. Filmmaker David Heilbrower, who inherited access to Hancock Beach, acknowledged that he thought it was unfair.Ready to Make a Smarter Property Decision? Build Your Legacy with TOI Homes.

El-Sayed, who is seeking the Democratic nomination for the US Senate seat in November’s midterms, will face a high-stakes general election battle against Republican Mike Rogers. The former US Representative is backed by President Donald Trump.

Addressing the state of Muslim American belonging, El-Sayed said that “at their best, being Muslim makes us better Americans … and being American enables us to be better Muslims,” he said. He added that the two sets of ideals are “not mutually exclusive.”

articles.body: At least five people have died after an Amazon cargo Boeing 767-300 plane crashed into vehicles and caught fire while overshooting the runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday, officials said.The aircraft overran the runway at around 2 pm Sunday after arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, killing five people and critically injuring three others, while two more sustained less severe injuries, Miami-Dade County officials said at a news conference.Miami-Dade Rescue Fire chief Ray Jadallah said several people were trapped inside vehicles following the crash, while the pilot and copilot were also trapped inside the aircraft. Fire crews continued to deal with a fuel leak several hours after the crash, he told news agency AP.More than 60 Miami-Dade Fire Rescue units rushed to the scene, where they found the aircraft on fire. Crews worked to extinguish the flames and assess and treat those injured.Video footage showed the aircraft positioned alongside a road after it went off the runway.A huge plume of black smoke can be seen rising high into the sky in the video.The aircraft “overran the runway after landing at Miami International Airport around 2 pm local time,” the FAA said in a statement to CNN.The Prime Air aircraft came to rest beside a roadway near two semi-trucks, according to images from the scene. The plane appeared to be resting on its belly and remained largely intact despite the fire.The flight was operated by North Carolina-based cargo carrier 21 Air. The 32-year-old Boeing 767 was originally built as a passenger aircraft and flew for several airlines for more than two decades before being converted into a cargo plane in 2015, according to flight-tracking website Flightradar24.Around 250 flights were delayed at the airport by late Sunday afternoon, according to FlightAware, which tracks flight disruptions.The National Transportation Safety Board said it was sending a team led by Chairwoman Jennifer Homendy to Miami to investigate the crash.“We’re working closely with local authorities and officials to understand exactly what happened,” Amazon spokesperson Kelly Nantel said in a social media post. “Right now, our absolute priority is the safety, well-being, and care of everyone involved.”The Boeing 767-300 cargo aircraft had departed from Luis Munoz Marin International Airport in San Juan, Puerto Rico, the FAA said.Catch the latest World News and Live updates. articles.title: WWE star Cody Rhodes, others hunt for John Cena in Clash of Clans, recalls why legend was booted from group
articles.summary: Cody Rhodes and the Clash of Clans community are hunting John Cena's base in a new crossover event featuring WWE legends as playable hero characters.
articles.body: John Cena’s in-ring career may have come to a close, but WWE star Cody Rhodes is still dealing with him virtually. Rhodes, Cena and several other WWE stars are a part of a second innovative crossover with Clash of Clans, the beloved mobile game that the "American Nightmare" has been playing for a decade. In this iteration, Rhodes and the rest of the Clash of Clans community are tasked with finding Cena’s base in the game. COMPLETE PRO WRESTLING COVERAGE ON OUTKICK The "Search for Cena" is officially on and lasts through Sept. 30. "We've got millions of players on Clash of Clans globally, global chat being back to millions of players," Rhodes told OutKick Dropkick hours before Sunday Night’s Main Event. "And when I was in a clan, that was how I got in Clash of Clans in the first place — John Cena on the road, all of us finding a game that we wanted to play and could bond over, and it was Clash. He had the O’Leary Klan (OLK) and he was a pretty good clan leader. He was until he wasn't -- real, real, real tyrant behavior, I would say, from the record-breaking John Cena. "And now we have the opportunity to get our receipt back, all of us, the entire Clash community, because we can get out there, find his base, raid it, get a three-star 100 on it. But probably the most pinch-yourself thing for me, and so much fun stuff happens working at WWE, so many fun moments and crossovers and things that we do, partnerships and things of this nature, to be able to open the game and see the Clash app logo with me against a barbarian, and then to get in there and see a new barbarian skin like the ‘Barbarian King’ skin, this is the second one, and now he's got the shades on and the music has been added. That's a trip." Rhodes previously told OutKick Dropkick that it was Cena who first got him into Clash of Clans. He was a part of the OLK before the group booted Cena. Rhodes and others then started the Nicky Clan, which still runs to this day. SIGN UP TO GET THE LATEST SPORTS NEWS "The American Nightmare" explained that what Cena was doing was akin to going to an NFL game and everyone is only kicking field goals. "I want to give him his due because he brings us all into the game. He certainly brings us all in. I think he was gemming a great amount — maybe too much gemming going on that not everyone wanted to do that. "I think he also was notorious for what we'd call the 99% one-star, which is, man, that is not good. That's like going to an NFL football game and them just doing field goals the whole game and nobody actually scoring a touchdown. You got to get the town hall. The fact that you're getting 99% one-stars is bringing the clan down. Very notorious for it, and I'd say pretty hard on the clan in general, but also a good clan leader because he was giving the good troops. He really was. Wasn't as easy back then, but he was giving the good troops." Cena said in a press release that his rivalry with Rhodes really began in Clash of Clans. "People think this started in the ring with Cody. It didn’t. It started when I out-raided him in the game and he threw me off his team," Cena said. "Ten years later he still needs help. This time he’s asking millions of you to take on my base. That’s fine. As I have always said - if you want some, come get some." Rhodes said it’s still a bit surreal to be featured in a game he had been playing for so long. It’s a little bit different than being in a pro wrestling video game, which most fans expect Rhodes to be in because he’s at the pinnacle of the sport. Rhodes has his own character as the "Barbarian King," which debuted last year. "I got a couple of great memories from the fact that I get to do this and the ‘Search for Cena,’ and he's the one who brought us into the game and finding his base. But also, to do the commercial for all this with one of the greatest of all time, that being Shawn Michaels as the wise Clash player, Clash brings us as a group together, and for the guys, some of the OG's, some of the luminaries, some of the legends who don't know Clash," he said. "Undertaker, for example. I remember texting him right away, ‘Hey, Clash of Clans, Supercell, this amazing company,’ and he's all in on it now, and he's on board, and this is his second time as the ‘Grand Warden.’ So, it's been a really good synergy that I don't think you would have ever expected, right? It doesn't seem like something that would happen. And maybe that's why it's so kind of at a loss for words almost over how cool this collaboration is." Rhodes is not the only WWE star featured in the game. Hero characters include Alexa Bliss as "Archer Queen," The Undertaker as "Grand Warden," Iyo Sky as "Royal Champion," Jey Uso as "Minion Prince" and Kane as "Dragon Duke." articles.title: In 2014, a tech entrepreneur bought a 1,100-acre Sonoma ranch for $12 million and spent about $33 million restoring it; 12 years later, it sold for a record $38.5 million
articles.summary: Real Estate News: A huge 1,100-acre estate high on the slopes of Sonoma Mountain has sold for $38.5 million (£29.2 million), setting a record for the highest residentia.
articles.body: A huge 1,100-acre estate high on the slopes of Sonoma Mountain has sold for $38.5 million (£29.2 million), setting a record for the highest residential property sale ever recorded in California's Sonoma County. The large agricultural property, known as The Summit and located at 3100 Sonoma Mountain Road, was bought in 2014 by tech entrepreneur Mark Leslie and his wife, Debra Leslie. According to property records and reporting by The Wall Street Journal, the couple paid $12 million for the undeveloped land and later spent another $33 million to redesign, restore and build a highly self-sufficient private estate. The sale broke the previous county record, set in 2023 when an estate in nearby Glen Ellen sold for $35 million.Transforming raw land into a self-sufficient compoundWhen the Leslies bought the land in 2014, the mountainous property was mostly undeveloped and needed years of earthworks, infrastructure work and landscape restoration. During their 12 years of ownership, they turned the hilltop into a large private estate, building a modern main house along with guest homes, barns and specialised farming facilities. Official MLS listings (ML82046933) show that the estate has 14,966 square feet of total living space across its buildings. It includes 10 bedrooms, seven full bathrooms and three partial bathrooms. The main house has large open-beam timber ceilings, floor-to-ceiling glass walls and stone fireplaces. Its design takes advantage of uninterrupted 360-degree views stretching from Mount Tamalpais and Mount Diablo across San Pablo Bay to the San Francisco skyline. Beyond the main living areas, the estate has major agricultural facilities, including three modern commercial greenhouses, a 12-car underground display garage and an independent off-grid energy system. The system uses large solar arrays, backup generators and deep freshwater wells.Extensive ecological restoration on Sonoma MountainA large part of the $33 million spent on improvements went towards restoring the natural environment across the 1,100-acre property. To improve natural drainage and reduce erosion on the steep canyon slopes, environmental crews removed invasive vegetation, strengthened natural creek beds and built several private lakes and fillable swimming basins. The project also included planting millions of seasonal daffodils alongside native oak trees, creating open meadows that provide a habitat corridor for local wildlife. The property also has fruit orchards, terraced organic vegetable gardens and dedicated vineyard areas suitable for winemaking. The property's remote location makes it one of the most private estates in Northern California, while still being less than an hour's drive from San Francisco.A landmark transaction for Northern California real estateThe property was first listed with an asking price of $39.995 million before selling for $38.5 million. MLSListings records show that the sale closed on August 21, with listing agents from Golden Gate Sotheby's International Realty and The Dreyfus Group representing the transaction. "The Summit is a world entirely of its own, offering an unmatched level of privacy, seclusion, and self-sufficiency in one of Northern California's most breathtaking natural settings," the listing agency's marketing material stated. The buyer's identity has not been revealed in public county land records. However, real estate brokers familiar with the deal said wealthy buyers continue to value large and secure properties in coastal California that offer full off-grid independence while remaining close to major technology centres.Ready to Make a Smarter Property Decision? articles.title: Iran claims strike on a U.S. ship in the Strait of Hormuz but the U.S. denies it
articles.summary: Iran said Sunday it struck an unmanned U.S. vessel trying to enter the Strait of Hormuz, a claim that the U.S. military dismissed as a “total lie.”
articles.body: CAIRO — Iran said Sunday it struck an unmanned U.S. vessel trying to enter the Strait of Hormuz, a claim that the U.S. military dismissed as a “total lie.” The purported attack came a day after the U.S. military said forces struck three Iranian oil tankers in response to Navy warships being targeted with ballistic missiles. Experts called it a dangerous escalation after Iran’s previous attacks at sea targeted commercial shipping. The war began with U.S. and Israeli attacks on Iran on Feb. 28. But since a fragile ceasefire agreement was announced in June, on-and-off fighting has persisted, with both sides trying to inflict military and economic pain as negotiations have collapsed. Strikes came about a week after fighting resumed The United States and Iran resumed attacks last week, following a month of relative calm, with the Strait of Hormuz and areas along Iran’s southern coast again being targeted. At least five people were killed earlier in the week during a U.S. bombardment that returned attention to the area where a school was hit in the war’s opening strikes. The Trump administration appears to have adopted a dual-prong approach to the conflict, responding militarily to attacks on the strait while going after foreign financial institutions that handle Iran’s money. But Tehran’s hard-line new senior leaders have signaled a willingness to dig in after weathering decades of sanctions. Iran has found ways over the years to circumvent sanctions, and now a U.S. blockade of its ports, and get its oil to buyers to help ease growing economic pressures. That relies in part on a shadow fleet transporting its oil. U.S. says million barrels of oil a day pass through the strait Tehran’s new leverage focuses on the Strait of Hormuz that is crucial to global oil and natural gas shipments. It was seen as an international waterway before the war began. On Sunday, U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright said that on average, 9 million barrels of oil a day are getting through the strait, which should help to relieve pressure on energy prices. His estimate appeared to exceed average flows over the past 28 days through the strait, according to TankerTrackers.com and other sources. Wright told CNN that with oil also flowing through pipelines in the region, “we’re probably two-thirds or more of pre-conflict flows.” But those flows depend on the presence of the U.S. Navy to help escort tankers and provide some protection against possible Iranian attack. Wright said he expected that other countries would eventually support the Navy’s efforts. Meanwhile, Iran’s nuclear program, the issue that contributed to the outbreak of the war, was meant to be addressed in negotiations that fell apart soon after the U.S. and Iran signed a memorandum of understanding in mid-June. Diplomats say the U.S., Britain, France and Germany now seek to refer Iran to the U.N. Security Council for failure to comply with its nuclear nonproliferation obligations.
